entities.summary: Lebanon is a sovereign nation in West Asia, Asia. Its capital is Beirut. Official languages include Arabic. Government: Unitary parliamentary confessionalist republic. Population: approximately 5.5 million. Area: 10,452 km². Comprehensive index for Lebanon covering Phoenician city-states (Byblos, Tyre, Sidon), invention of alphabet, Persian/Hellenistic periods, Roman Berytus law school, early Christianity (Maronites), Arab conquest, Crusader County of Tripoli, Mamluk/Ottoman rule, Druze-Maronite conflicts, Mount Lebanon Mutasarrifate, French Mandate, independence 1943, National Pact confessionalism, 1958 crisis, Palestinian refugee crisis, civil war 1975-1990, Taif Agreement, Syrian occupation, Cedar Revolution 2005, 2006 Israel-Hezbollah war, Beirut port explosion 2020, and ongoing political-economic crisis.
